rulings.Case Title: BENEDICTA BECERRA VS. ERNESTO RODRIGUEZ ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT , In The Alternative, For Summary Adjudication In Favor Of Plaintiff
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for September 8, 2026. Line 1. PLAINTIFF BENEDICTA BECERRA MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT , In The Alternative, For Summary Adjudication In Favor Of Plaintiff is DENIED. No competent evidence provided that Defendant remains in possession "as of the date of this motion." See Separate Statement, fact 11. The motion deeming admissions admitted was granted on July 27, 2026, a month before this motion was filed. Becerra Declaration, paragraph 7 does not contain any evidence as to possession. To the extent Plaintiff erroneously listed paragraph 7, as supporting evidence for fact 11, and it should have referenced to paragraph 6 (the only paragraph of Becerra declaration addressing possession), that paragraphs does not contain competent admissible evidence. rulings.Case Title: 57 TAYLOR I7, LP VS. JONATHAN CUTRER ET AL
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for September 8, 2026. Line 11. PLAINTIFF 57 TAYLOR I7, LP MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT is DENIED without prejudice. Moving party points to no evidence that Defendant remains in possession. In the Memorandum of Points and Authorities (3:21), Plaintiff states that defendant remain in possession pointing to Chen Decl., 13, Exhibit 2. Chen Declaration paragraph 13 in turn points to "Exhibit 2, RFA, pg. 3, 16-18." Exhibit. 2 appears to include two documents: an Order Granting Plaintiff's Motion for Order that the Truth of the Matters be Deemed Admitted and Plaintiff's Request for Admissions, Set One to Defendant Jonathan Cutrer. It is not clear if the citation to evidence in paragraph 13 of Chen Declaration points to page 3 of the entire Exhibit. 2 or at the 3rd page of the RFAs. The first option lands on the caption page of Plaintiff's Request for Admissions, Set One to Defendant Jonathan Cutrer, which has not paragraphs. The second option lands on page that starts with "Request for Admission No. 8" and ends with the text of "Request for Admission No. 16;" and also contains no paragraphs. To the extent Plaintiff meant to refer to Requests for Admission numbers and not to "paragraphs," there is only request for admission 16 on this page and it states: "Admit that PLAINTIFF'S dominant motive for seeking possession of the PREMISES is nonpayment of rent as enumerated in the San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9(a)(1)(A)." It has nothing to do with possession. rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for September 8, 2026. Line 4. DEFENDANT DEIDRA CAHUA, PILAR PAYTON MOTION TO STRIKE Amended COMPLAINT is DENIED without prejudice. Motion is based upon, and specifically cites to, defects in Exhibit A to the Request for Judicial Notice, which are not present. Contrary to the statement in Defendants' Request for Judicial Notice, Exhibit A is not a true and correct copy of the Third Amended Complaint for Unlawful Detainer filed in this action, which per Defendants' Memorandum was filed on August 11, 2026. Exhibit A bears a file stamp dated May 18, 2026, and does not purport to be an amended complaint.
